doc.title: Mrs. Mary Lucy Hamill O'Kelly Interview, 1958-05-04

title: Opening and request for biographical details
summary: The interviewer announces the recording date (May 4, 1958) and asks for name, birthplace and years in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: All right, first of all, this is being recorded in Paschus Jan, April 4th, 1958. May the 4th, darling. May the 4th, 1958. Getting mixed up to start off with. All right, now, first I'd like you to tell your name, your birthplace, your date, when you lived in New Orleans, and so on, and which you... And then we'll start off on memories of jazz.
